Separately, your last email mentioned a "surge" billing behavior if we exceed the concurrency cap during the final run. Hi Maya — appreciate the heads up and totally reasonable ask. Two quick options that keep the final bill predictable:

1) Time-box extension (2 weeks) + Accelerator Pack (recommended)
   - Accelerator Pack = 100k token burst + temporary 50% higher concurrency ceiling for the extension window.
   - Single one-off fee: $3,500 for the 2-week period.
   - Includes automated prefix caching warmup and priority routing to avoid transient latency spikes during final validation.

2) Time-box extension (2 weeks) + top-up credits (pay-as-you-go)
   - Top-up credits in 10k-token buckets at $0.015 / 1k tokens (applies only to overage tokens).
   - No concurrency guarantee; if concurrency is exceeded we'll apply surge pricing at 1.5x standard per-token until you purchase a burst pack.

If budget predictability is the priority, Accelerator Pack is usually cleaner. If you prefer to try a lower-cost route first we can provision a small top-up and monitor usage; we can auto-promote to Accelerator Pack if you hit the concurrency threshold.

I've attached an updated pricing brief with both options and a draft POc addendum for the extension so your legal/procurement team can review.

If that sounds good I can route the approval through finance for a one-time promo — happy to propose a 10% concession for the Accelerator Pack in this situation (to help offset your integration delay).

Best,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
